name: 陳斌豪
objective:
The course is a fundamental carriers transport analysis method for performing energy transport and conversion. These methods are essentially a theoretical analysis; the course teach student to set up various energy carriers including; atom, molecular, electron, phonon, photon. Course lectures are listed as:
1.	introduction
2.     review of basic transport process: charge, gas and energy transfer 
3.	Macro & Nano Transport Phenomena	
4.     Schrödinger Equation and Material Waves
5.     Electronic Levels in One-Dimensional Lattice Chain
6.    Fundamental of Statistical Thermodynamics 
5.
課程進度(1-16週):
week 1: introduction to multiscale transport phenomena;fuel cell system
week 2-3: numerical method review
week 4-7: review of basic transport process
week 8: project 1 
week 9-10:topics of nano scale transport
week 11-13:methods for nano-scale transport: Molecular Dynamics
week 14-17: Crystal Bonding and Electronic Energy Levels in Crystals 
week 18: project 4, final exam
